# UIcockpit

> The open-source design system generator. Nine real UI kits rendered on one
> screen with one set of values, so you can try them in your own colours and
> export the one you keep as your design system. Free, no sign-up, everything
> runs in the browser.

The nine kits: Tailwind CSS, daisyUI, Bootstrap, shadcn/ui, Material 3
(@material/web), Radix Themes, Mantine, Ant Design and Open Props. Nothing is
imitated: every class, variable, component and icon is read from the kit's own
published package, gaps are declared by name, and the claim is enforced by
build gates (a class the kit's CSS does not define fails the build).

The export is a zip: theme.css in each kit's own vocabulary, DESIGN.md to
Google's design system spec, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules, install.md
and a MANIFEST.md with versions, licences and what could not be set. There is
no npm package, CLI or MCP server for this version; the exported files carry
the agent-facing contract themselves.

## Pages

- [The generator](https://uicockpit.com/generator): pick a stack, start from
  a kit's own defaults, turn the knobs, compare side by side, export.
- [Source code](https://github.com/AlexanderKaan/uicockpit): MIT licensed.
